name: Chroma
description: Chroma is an open-source search and retrieval database for AI applications. It stores embeddings together with documents and metadata and answers vector similarity, metadata-filtered and full-text queries over an HTTP API, with official Python and JavaScript clients.

notes.text: The Chroma server has no authentication. Keep port 8000 on a trusted network or put a reverse proxy with authentication in front of it.
Connect with chromadb.HttpClient(host="<IP>", port=8000); the API reference is served at http://<IP>:8000/docs.
